cohort.screen: every shot absent from the complete 603-shot polarity population

magnitude_plausibility.comparison: per-frame unclaimed L1 ampere-turns against the absolute released ampere-turn current of every shipped poloidal conductor
magnitude_plausibility.interpretation: scale comparison only; it cannot establish origin alone

non_gs_accounting.construction: extract p-prime and FF-prime from each label, solve the fixed-border profile equation, apply Delta-star to label minus solution, and integrate exterior L1 apparent toroidal current

position_stability.physical_position_rule: a cluster spans at least fifteen of twenty shots and both its radial and vertical peak-to-peak spreads do not exceed 0.021 m

resolution_dependence.operation: take every second R and Z node, then repeat Delta-star and patch detection
unchanged: label map values on retained nodes
LCFS mask values on retained nodes

verdict.artefact: non-GS apparent current explains at least 80 percent and either no position-stable cluster exists or the decimated total or patch count changes by more than 20 percent
verdict.mixed: neither the artefact nor physical conjunction is met
verdict.physical: a position-stable cluster exists, non-GS apparent current explains at most 20 percent, and both resolution changes are at most 20 percent
